rule: A corpus is a dated directory kept whole. It is included when a protocol document, the gap register, the validity ledger, a capture or verifier script, or a retained check recipe cites a path equal to or inside it, or when the manifest, plan, verification, review, README, index or sums file (at most 3 MB) of an included corpus cites a path inside it. A citation of evidence/ or of a bare date directory selects nothing. Every other corpus is excluded. Withheld files are listed in withheld.json and counted apart.
